scope: Publish existing draft rem-sleep-disorder → parkinsons-disease prodromal edge (ME-14) as the first published outgoing relationship from rem-sleep-disorder; add governanceNotes schema field for published-mapping governance records; resolve schema blocker (draft:false + non-empty todo) that prevented publication.

relationships.rationale: REM sleep behavior disorder is a recognized prodromal marker for synucleinopathy (primarily Parkinson disease); RBD patients have substantially elevated 5-year and 10-year phenoconversion risk. This is a temporal-risk / predictive association, not a causal or aggravation pathway.
relationships.publicationGuard: REM sleep behavior disorder is a prodromal marker or risk state for later synucleinopathy (primarily Parkinson disease), not a cause of Parkinson disease. Many RBD patients do not convert during observed follow-up. Dementia with Lewy bodies and multiple system atrophy remain alternative phenoconversion outcomes.
evidenceGaps: Longitudinal phenoconversion rate in veterans specifically (most RBD→PD data from non-veteran cohorts)
MRI or neuroimaging biomarker progression correlating with RBD severity
Whether veteran-specific comorbidities (TBI, PTSD) accelerate or modify phenoconversion timeline
Differential phenoconversion rates between idiopathic RBD and PTSD-associated dream enactment
Prospective data on RBD treatment (melatonin, clonazepam) effect on phenoconversion risk

sourceReferences.citation: Postuma RB, et al. Risk and predictors of dementia conversion in isolated REM sleep behavior disorder. Neurology. 2020;94(15):e1565-e1575. PMID 20083800.
sourceReferences.note: Primary prospective cohort study quantifying phenoconversion risk from isolated RBD to Parkinson disease and other synucleinopathies.

schemaChange.description: Added optional governanceNotes array to conditionMappingSchema to allow published mappings (draft:false) to preserve governance decision records without triggering the 'Resolve every todo before publishing' validation rule. Governance notes are non-blocking metadata; todo remains the active work tracker.

documentedConsideredButNotEntered: REM → Dementia with Lewy Bodies (DLB): prodromal phenoconversion target per Bourassa and Postuma literature, but DLB does not yet exist as a catalog condition. Deferred to future catalog expansion.
REM → Multiple System Atrophy (MSA): same phenoconversion literature, same catalog gap. Deferred.
mTBI → REM Sleep Disorder: Elliott 2020 showed TBI+PTSD at 3.43× OR for RBD, but isolated mTBI evidence is thinner. Deferred to future evidence review.
Husain 2001 (PMID 11435805): small veteran study (n=27), superseded by Elliott 2020. Not entered as a source.
Shahkhali 2025 medRxiv preprint: non-peer-reviewed; MR analysis found no causal support. Used only as no-causation guard evidence, not a verified source.
